purpose: Provide an independently reviewable route to a valid Train/Development inventory and a future blinded Held-Out readiness decision without changing or bypassing the frozen v2 NO-GO lock.

task_roles.train: May be used for model exposure and learning only after explicit assignment and separate training authorization.
task_roles.development: May be used for matched policy comparison and tuning only after explicit assignment; never reclassified as Held-Out.
task_roles.heldout: Custodian-controlled evaluation assets remain invisible to model operators, prompt construction, training, and Development selection until an approved independent evaluation event.

family_review_inputs: changed source paths and patch fingerprint
test paths and normalized test behavior fingerprint
upstream issue/PR ancestry and related backports
identity_and_deduplication.deduplication_rule: Treat same-task variants, backports, cherry-picks, patch-equivalent changes, and tasks with materially overlapping acceptance contracts as one family. Exclude a family if any member was previously exposed, assigned, rolled out, graded with feedback, or used in a training/Development run.

required_hashes: source repository URL, commit, and relevant source blobs
task patch and clean baseline tree
public test files and exact selectors
trusted grader code, configuration, and dependency image digest
qualification_arms: baseline fails at the intended assertion
independently authored wrong mutant fails the same assertion
fixed candidate passes the exact selector
provenance_and_qualification.environment_rule: Run only pre-frozen selectors in an isolated CPU-only or explicitly task-compatible image with network disabled. A missing dependency or isolation failure is UNSUPPORTED, never a task negative or qualification pass.
provenance_and_qualification.trusted_grading: Bind an independently maintained grader result to the candidate patch digest and immutable trajectory head; no model receives hidden expected output or heldout feedback.

assignment_order: freeze a metadata-only inventory and exposure exclusions
an independent custodian qualifies source/tests/graders and reviews task families inside a sealed evaluator environment; model operators and prompt authors receive no task content
the custodian assigns Train, Development, or Held-Out and commits the assignment before any content is exposed to model operators
publish only assignment counts and a cryptographic commitment; retain identities and split secrets with the custodian
only then permit explicitly authorized Train or Development content to the designated model/prompt team
split_and_exposure_controls.heldout_split: An independent custodian assigns eligible families before any model exposure using a precommitted secret-seeded procedure; the public record contains a commitment and counts, not task identities or prompts.
split_and_exposure_controls.leakage_rule: No source, tests, grader, prompt, task-family fingerprint, or intermediate result from Held-Out may enter Train, Development, prompt design, or model context. Remove contaminated family members from all splits.
split_and_exposure_controls.heldout_custodian: A named evaluator independent of model training owns Held-Out source, tests, graders, allocation secret, and evaluation execution. Policy operators receive only aggregate approved metrics after the frozen comparison closes.
split_and_exposure_controls.content_review_segregation: Any person who reviews candidate source, tests, task text, or grader inputs for qualification and family deduplication is excluded from model/prompt construction and training unless the task is assigned Train or Development and that exposure is explicitly authorized. Held-Out qualification remains custodian-only.
split_and_exposure_controls.exposure_registry: Maintain a private, append-only registry of candidate identity, task-family key, model/prompt exposure, grading feedback, run IDs, and split. The public protocol publishes only the registry digest and exclusion counts.

successor_readiness_decision.counting_rule: Count only independently source-qualified, grader-qualified, non-exposed, non-duplicated task families assigned Held-Out before model exposure. Train and Development tasks count as zero.
required_decision_fields: unique task-family count and deduplication review hash
explicit GO or NO_GO and claim boundary
successor_readiness_decision.go_effect: A successor GO permits only the separately specified experiment. It does not itself authorize model inference, training, or deployment; those require explicit run authorization and matched Development evaluation.

evaluation_metrics_for_future_protocol: task success under independent trusted grading
trusted reward distribution and between-sample variance
time to first useful source read and first valid edit
